KEEP THE QUESTION HONEST

More messages do not mean more competitors.

Posting activity, people, teams and valid submissions are different quantities. This dataset records the first; it does not estimate the others.

MESSAGE EXPLORER / TRACE THE CLAIM

an observed message.

Anonymous display-label aliases and concise paraphrases preserve the analytical signal. Source links let authorized server members review context.

CHANNEL BY CHANNEL

Coverage comes first

No activity ranking

How to read these measures

Observed messages
Distinct message IDs in the loaded sample. This is not a search result total or a full channel count.
Display labels
Anonymous aliases for visible display labels, within a sample. They are not verified unique accounts, people or teams.
Content shares
Messages in a category divided by all coded messages in the selected sample. Each message has one category.
Missing values
Unread channels, unverified timezones and unknown counts remain null. They do not become zero.
Staff and bots
Roles are shown only when explicit evidence is recorded. No complete author-role roster has been verified, and the samples do not claim to exclude all staff or bots.
Time and comparisons
Messages per hour and cross-challenge rankings are withheld because coverage is incomplete and not comparable.

Build-A-Dataset eligibility

The written guide requires physical-world primary collection. You report organizer permission for remote observations; the scope of that exception has not been independently verified. The guide’s published text allows web data as a supplement. Simulated records remain simulated and do not establish that teams were contacted.

Judging rubric · 100 points total

Data collection & quality 20Functionality & data integration 20Creativity & originality 20Usefulness & impact 20Communication & presentation 20

The submission requires a GitHub repository with code, shareable dataset, method, data dictionary and run instructions, plus an approximately two-minute demonstration video through Devpost.

A THOUGHT EXPERIMENT / NOT A FORECAST
